en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a tree‑lined dirt road curving toward a large brick building in the background. The scene looks semi‑rural, with mature deciduous trees on the left, coniferous trees on the right, and telegraph or power poles following the road. The multi‑story brick building has a steep, gabled roof; a small cross or finial sits at the roof peak, suggesting a religious institution or school. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
